chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Saeed ibn Janah, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him) who said:
When the man reaches middle age, he should not leave eating something at night, for it is a gift for sleep and more aromatic for the breath.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating at night for middle-aged men according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) advises middle-aged men to consume a light evening meal, linking physical well-being to marital harmony. This guidance reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing spiritual discipline with natural bodily needs, ensuring that one’s health supports both worship and family life.
